# Error reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_contracts.py from backend/app/contracts/error_catalog.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every error DisPatch returns carries a stable `error.code`. The HTTP body keeps the
2.x `detail` string and adds the catalogued object:

```json
{"detail": "Thread not found",
 "error": {"code": "thread_not_found", "message": "Thread not found",
           "fix": "Pick a thread from the list; it may have been deleted.",
           "docs": "thread_not_found"}}
```

Branch on `error.code`, never on the message. Machine callers additionally receive an
RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` document with the same `error` object.

| Code | HTTP | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| [`advisor_request_unknown`](#advisor_request_unknown) | 404 | Unknown request |
| [`agent_backend_rejected`](#agent_backend_rejected) | 409 | The agent backend refused that request. |
| [`agent_backend_unavailable`](#agent_backend_unavailable) | 503 | The agent backend is not available. |
| [`agent_budget_exhausted`](#agent_budget_exhausted) | 429 | This agent's budget for today is used up. |
| [`agent_credentials_invalid`](#agent_credentials_invalid) | 422 | The credentials were not accepted. |
| [`agent_disabled`](#agent_disabled) | 409 | That agent is switched off. |
| [`agent_gateway_down`](#agent_gateway_down) | 503 | The agent gateway is not connected |
| [`agent_has_active_tasks`](#agent_has_active_tasks) | 409 | That agent has tasks that are still running. |

## advisor_request_unknown

<a id="advisor_request_unknown"></a>

HTTP **404** - Unknown request

**Fix:** The thing you asked for does not exist; reload and pick it again.

## agent_backend_rejected

<a id="agent_backend_rejected"></a>

HTTP **409** - The agent backend refused that request.

**Fix:** The backend cannot do this (for example steer a running OpenClaw turn). Stop the task or wait for it to finish.

## agent_backend_unavailable

<a id="agent_backend_unavailable"></a>

HTTP **503** - The agent backend is not available.

**Fix:** Check Settings, Agents, Backends: OpenClaw must run on this machine, and the Claude Agent needs an API key and the optional agents-claude extra.

## agent_budget_exhausted

<a id="agent_budget_exhausted"></a>

HTTP **429** - This agent's budget for today is used up.

**Fix:** Raise the daily limit in Settings, Agents, or try again tomorrow. Costs are estimates.

## agent_credentials_invalid

<a id="agent_credentials_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - The credentials were not accepted.

**Fix:** Paste an Anthropic Console API key, or pick Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud or Microsoft Foundry and configure that provider's own credentials on this machine.

## agent_disabled

<a id="agent_disabled"></a>

HTTP **409** - That agent is switched off.

**Fix:** Switch it on in Settings, Agents.

## agent_gateway_down

<a id="agent_gateway_down"></a>

HTTP **503** - The agent gateway is not connected

**Fix:** Start the OpenClaw gateway, or switch the character to a direct provider.

## agent_has_active_tasks

<a id="agent_has_active_tasks"></a>

HTTP **409** - That agent has tasks that are still running.

**Fix:** Stop or wait for its tasks, or switch the agent off instead of deleting it.

## agent_invalid

<a id="agent_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - The agent definition is not valid.

**Fix:** Fix the field named in the message (a tool list, a budget, an MCP server) and save again.

## agent_name_taken

<a id="agent_name_taken"></a>

HTTP **409** - An agent with that name already exists.

**Fix:** Choose a different name.

## agent_needs_owner

<a id="agent_needs_owner"></a>

HTTP **403** - Only an Admin can give an agent that capability.

**Fix:** Ask an Admin. Running repository hooks, starting local MCP programs and unattended destructive tools are host-level powers.

## agent_not_found

<a id="agent_not_found"></a>

HTTP **404** - Agent not found

**Fix:** Pick an agent from the list; it may be switched off, deleted, or not published to your profile.

## agents_only

<a id="agents_only"></a>

HTTP **403** - Only agents may fire reactions

**Fix:** This endpoint is for agents holding the API key; a signed-in person cannot call it.

## api_key_required

<a id="api_key_required"></a>

HTTP **401** - API key required

**Fix:** Send the API key as X-API-Key.

## approval_not_found

<a id="approval_not_found"></a>

HTTP **404** - That approval request is not pending any more.

**Fix:** The task moved on (it was stopped, timed out, or someone else answered). Reload the task.

## approval_scope_not_allowed

<a id="approval_scope_not_allowed"></a>

HTTP **422** - That approval can only be given for this one call.

**Fix:** Destructive tools ask every time. Choose 'once'.

## archive_invalid

<a id="archive_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - months must be a whole number from 1 to 120.

**Fix:** Send months as null (off) or a whole number from 1 to 120.

## archived_not_bool

<a id="archived_not_bool"></a>

HTTP **400** - archived must be true or false

**Fix:** Send archived as true (archive the chat) or false (move it back).

## avatar_invalid

<a id="avatar_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - That file is not a picture DisPatch can read.

**Fix:** Send a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.

## avatar_not_capturable

<a id="avatar_not_capturable"></a>

HTTP **409** - The bot has no capturable avatar right now

**Fix:** The state conflicts with the request; reload and retry.

## avatar_not_found

<a id="avatar_not_found"></a>

HTTP **404** - Avatar not found

**Fix:** The character has no avatar of that kind yet.

## avatar_not_raster

<a id="avatar_not_raster"></a>

HTTP **400** - Avatar must be a raster image

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

## avatar_pool_missing

<a id="avatar_pool_missing"></a>

HTTP **404** - No avatar pool for that bot

**Fix:** The thing you asked for does not exist; reload and pick it again.

## avatar_snapshot_failed

<a id="avatar_snapshot_failed"></a>

HTTP **500** - Could not store the avatar snapshot

**Fix:** This is a server fault; check the logs (Settings > System) and retry.

## avatar_source_required

<a id="avatar_source_required"></a>

HTTP **400** - Send an image file, or pass source=current

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

## avatar_too_large

<a id="avatar_too_large"></a>

HTTP **413** - The picture is too large (25 MB at most).

**Fix:** Send a smaller picture.

## avatar_write_failed

<a id="avatar_write_failed"></a>

HTTP **500** - Could not write the avatar

**Fix:** This is a server fault; check the logs (Settings > System) and retry.

## backend_invalid

<a id="backend_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - backend must be 'direct' or 'legacy-api'

**Fix:** Fix the fields in detail and resend.

## backend_not_allowed

<a id="backend_not_allowed"></a>

HTTP **403** - Your profile may not choose a bot's backend.

**Fix:** Ask an Admin to allow the connection for this profile in People.

## backend_unavailable

<a id="backend_unavailable"></a>

HTTP **503** - The image backend is unavailable.

**Fix:** ComfyUI is starting or briefly down. DisPatch retries.

## backends_invalid

<a id="backends_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - backends must be an object.

**Fix:** Send {"allowed": [connection ids]} or {} for every connection.

## backends_unknown_connection

<a id="backends_unknown_connection"></a>

HTTP **422** - Unknown connection.

**Fix:** Use a connection id from GET /api/connections.

## backup_confirm_required

<a id="backup_confirm_required"></a>

HTTP **422** - Restoring replaces your current data

**Fix:** Send confirm: true to go ahead.

## backup_corrupt

<a id="backup_corrupt"></a>

HTTP **400** - The backup file is damaged

**Fix:** Try another backup; this one cannot be read or failed its checks.

## backup_not_found

<a id="backup_not_found"></a>

HTTP **404** - Unknown backup

**Fix:** List the backups with GET /api/backups.

## backup_passphrase_required

<a id="backup_passphrase_required"></a>

HTTP **400** - A backup passphrase is required

**Fix:** Send a passphrase (at least 8 characters), or set one in Settings > System.

## backup_protected

<a id="backup_protected"></a>

HTTP **409** - That backup is protected

**Fix:** Pre-migration copies are kept until they age out.

## backup_wrong_key

<a id="backup_wrong_key"></a>

HTTP **400** - The passphrase is wrong, or this is not a DisPatch backup

**Fix:** Enter the passphrase or recovery key the backup was made with.

## bad_request

<a id="bad_request"></a>

HTTP **400** - Bad request.

**Fix:** Check the request body against the API reference.

## basic_no_bots

<a id="basic_no_bots"></a>

HTTP **422** - A Basic profile uses the bots an Admin gives it; it has none of its own.

**Fix:** Ask an Admin to add household bots to this profile, or to make it a User.

<a id="before_invalid"></a>

HTTP **400** - before must be an ISO-8601 timestamp

## before_required

<a id="before_required"></a>

HTTP **400** - before (ISO timestamp) required

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

## body_not_object

<a id="body_not_object"></a>

HTTP **422** - body must be an object

**Fix:** Fix the fields in detail and resend.

## bot_config_write_failed

<a id="bot_config_write_failed"></a>

HTTP **500** - Failed to update bot config

**Fix:** This is a server fault; check the logs (Settings > System) and retry.

<a id="bot_id_missing"></a>

HTTP **400** - Unknown or missing bot_id

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

<a id="bot_id_taken"></a>

HTTP **409** - A bot with the id {} already exists

HTTP **400** - Unknown bot_id

HTTP **404** - Unknown bot

HTTP **409** - This bot belongs to an app; remove or disable the app instead

**Fix:** The state conflicts with the request; reload and retry.

HTTP **503** - The image captioner is unavailable.

**Fix:** The captioning model is busy. DisPatch retries.

HTTP **422** - That character change is not valid

HTTP **409** - A DisPatch install needs at least one bot

<a id="check_failed"></a>

HTTP **422** - Could not check {}

HTTP **400** - checked must be a boolean for a row update

HTTP **400** - checked entries must be integers

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

HTTP **400** - checked must be a list of row indices

HTTP **400** - invalid client id

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

HTTP **429** - Too many image renders in flight.

HTTP **422** - That connection is not valid

HTTP **422** - That address is not valid

## daily_upload_limit

<a id="daily_upload_limit"></a>

HTTP **429** - Daily machine upload limit reached — try again tomorrow

**Fix:** Programs holding the API key may upload 200 MB a day together (the machine guard, people have no limit). It resets at local midnight; an Admin can change it in Settings > People & Access > Machines.

HTTP **422** - day must be YYYY-MM-DD

**Fix:** The thing you asked for does not exist; reload and pick it again.

## lock_target_fence

<a id="lock_target_fence"></a>

HTTP **422** - This is the shared default profile everyone lands on: agents and voice cloning cannot be switched on for it.

**Fix:** Grant it to a profile of its own, or make another profile the default first.

## lock_target_invalid

<a id="lock_target_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - Pick an existing, enabled profile.

**Fix:** Choose a User or Basic profile (not an Admin) that exists and is enabled, or the profile list.

## machine_scope_denied

<a id="machine_scope_denied"></a>

HTTP **403** - This API key is not allowed to call that endpoint.

**Fix:** Send an API key whose machine scopes include the one shown in required_permission (security.yaml machine_scopes).

## maintenance_blocked

<a id="maintenance_blocked"></a>

HTTP **409** - Maintenance is paused: the maintenance marker is set or a backup is running.

**Fix:** Wait for the backup or the box maintenance to finish; the task retries on its own every 30 minutes.

## maintenance_running

<a id="maintenance_running"></a>

HTTP **409** - A maintenance run is already in progress.

**Fix:** Wait for it to finish (GET /api/maintenance/status), then run it again if you still need to.

## maintenance_step_unknown

<a id="maintenance_step_unknown"></a>

HTTP **422** - Unknown maintenance step.

**Fix:** Use the step names a dry run (POST /api/maintenance/run with dry_run: true) lists.

## max_tokens_invalid

<a id="max_tokens_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - max_tokens must be a whole number

**Fix:** Fix the fields in detail and resend.

**Fix:** The thing you asked for does not exist; reload and pick it again.

**Fix:** The message may have been deleted; reload the thread.

## mood_face_missing

**Fix:** The thing you asked for does not exist; reload and pick it again.

HTTP **503** - The workflow needs more GPUs than the image server has.

**Fix:** The workflow needs more GPUs than the image server's ComfyUI was started with. Pick a single-GPU workflow or restart the server with more cards.

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

## not_copyable

<a id="not_copyable"></a>

HTTP **422** - This bot runs on an agent and cannot be copied.

**Fix:** Only direct-API household bots can be copied.

## not_found

HTTP **404** - Not found

**Fix:** Check the address.

<a id="nothing_to_change"></a>

HTTP **400** - Nothing to change

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

## owner_exists

<a id="owner_exists"></a>

HTTP **409** - This install already has an owner.

**Fix:** An owner already exists. Sign in as the owner instead.

<a id="owner_immutable"></a>

HTTP **409** - The owner's role cannot be changed.

**Fix:** The owner's role cannot be changed, disabled or deleted here.

## owner_required

<a id="owner_required"></a>

HTTP **409** - Create the owner account first.

**Fix:** Create the owner account first (Settings > Account).

HTTP **404** - Clients panel disabled

**Fix:** Enable the feature in Settings > Plugins & Apps, or ignore this panel.

HTTP **400** - Password invalid.

**Fix:** Choose a password of at least 8 characters.

## password_required

<a id="password_required"></a>

HTTP **409** - Set a password for the owner first.

**Fix:** Set the owner's password first (Settings > Account).

## password_role

<a id="password_role"></a>

HTTP **409** - Only Admins have a password; User and Basic profiles use a PIN.

**Fix:** Only Admins have a password; User and Basic profiles use a PIN.

<a id="path_invalid"></a>

HTTP **403** - Your profile does not have permission to do that.

**Fix:** Ask an Admin to grant your profile the permission shown in required_permission.

## permissions_invalid

<a id="permissions_invalid"></a>

HTTP **400** - A permission is invalid.

**Fix:** Use the permission names from docs/contracts/permissions.json; a profile can only be granted what its type allows (contracts.permissions ROLE_GRANTABLE).

<a id="personal_needs_direct"></a>

HTTP **409** - This character has no direct AI connection, so it cannot answer.

**Fix:** Give the character a connection in its editor (personal characters run on a direct backend only).

## pin_invalid

<a id="pin_invalid"></a>

HTTP **400** - Pin invalid.

**Fix:** Choose a PIN of at least 4 characters.

HTTP **400** - No PIN is set

**Fix:** There is no PIN to check. Create the owner account in Settings > Account.

HTTP **400** - PIN must be at least {} characters

**Fix:** Choose a longer PIN.

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

**Fix:** The state conflicts with the request; reload and retry.

**Fix:** Fetch the role-change preview again and confirm with its new token.

<a id="setup_required"></a>

HTTP **403** - This DisPatch has no owner yet. Open it on the computer it runs on, or finish setup with the one-time setup token from the server log.

**Fix:** Open DisPatch on the computer it runs on, or finish setup with the one-time setup token printed in the server log (POST /api/auth/setup).

HTTP **401** - Sign in to continue.

**Fix:** Pick your profile on the sign-in screen (with its PIN or password if it has one). Unsigned devices land on the default profile only when an Admin has set one (Settings, People: lock target).

**Fix:** The render started and then went quiet. DisPatch retries once; if it keeps stalling, restart the image server.
